```python
import os
import sqlite3

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

        self.root = root
        self.root.title("Travel Memories Planner")
        self.root.geometry("800x600")

        # Create input fields for destination, dates, activities
        self.destination_label = tk.Label(root, text="Destination:")
        self.destination_label.pack()
        self.destination_entry = tk.Entry(root)

        self.activities_entry.pack()

        # Create button to upload photos
        self.upload_button = tk.Button(root, text="Upload Photos", command=self.upload_photos)
        self.upload_button.pack()

        # Create button to generate travel memory album
        self.generate_button = tk.Button(root, text="Generate Travel Memory Album", command=self.generate_album)
        self.generate_button.pack()

        # Create canvas to display travel memory album
        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(root, width=800, height=600)
        self.canvas.pack()

    def upload_photos(self):
        # Open file dialog to select photos
        file_path = filedialog.askopenfilename()
        # Store photo path in database
        conn = sqlite3.connect("travel_memories.db")
        c = conn.cursor()
        c.execute("INSERT INTO photos (path) VALUES (?)", (file_path,))
        conn.commit()
        conn.close()

    def generate_album(self):
        # Retrieve data from database
        conn = sqlite3.connect("travel_memories.db")
        c = conn.cursor()
        c.execute("SELECT * FROM photos")
        photos = c.fetchall()
        conn.close()

        # Use algorithms to organize and categorize data
        organized_photos = self.organize_photos(photos)

        # Use data visualization techniques to generate travel memory album
        self.display_album(organized_photos)

    def organize_photos(self, photos):
        # Implement algorithms to organize and categorize photos
        # For example, sort photos by date or location
        organized_photos = []
        for photo in photos:
            # Get photo path, date, and location from database
            photo_path = photo[1]
            date = photo[2]
            location = photo[3]
            # Organize photos by date or location
            organized_photos.append((photo_path, date, location))
        return organized_photos

    def display_album(self, organized_photos):
        # Use data visualization techniques to generate travel memory album
        # For example, use matplotlib to create a grid of photos
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(len(organized_photos), 1, figsize=(10, 10))
        for i, photo in enumerate(organized_photos):
            photo_path, date, location = photo
            # Display photo on canvas
            img = Image.open(photo_path)
            img.thumbnail((200, 200))
            img_tk = ImageTk.PhotoImage(img)
            ax[i].imshow(img_tk)
            ax[i].set_title(date + " - " + location)
        plt.show()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    root = tk.Tk()
    app = TravelMemoriesPlanner(root)
    root.mainloop()
```
